newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA's Warburton says economy looks good.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA's Warburton says economy looks good.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) board member Dick Warburton said on Wednesday that the Australian economy was performing very well, but some sectors were still patchy.
"Overall, I think the Australian economy is in extremely good health, but it is very segmental," he told reporters.
Warburton, a professional company director who is chairman of retailer David Jones Ltd and Sydney Harbour Casino Ltd, said he would not comment on the future direction of interest rates.

He said the lowering of the official cash rate three times since July last year was having a positive impact on the housing sector but the good news had not yet filtered through to the retailing sector.
Warburton was speaking before the start of a David Jones news conference.
